Phantom Wallet is a non-custodial wallet, so users hold their own private keys. Phantom Wallet is primarily associated with the Solana blockchain. Phantom Wallet also supports Ethereum and other EVM-compatible networks. Phantom Wallet is available as a browser extension and as a mobile app.

Binance Web3 Wallet is a non-custodial wallet, so users control their own private keys. Binance Web3 Wallet supports multiple blockchain networks. Binance Web3 Wallet is integrated with the Binance ecosystem.

Trust Wallet is a non-custodial wallet, so users hold their own private keys. Trust Wallet supports many blockchain networks. Trust Wallet is available as a mobile app and a browser extension. Trust Wallet is open source. Trust Wallet has been affiliated with Binance.

Coinbase Web3 Wallet is a non-custodial wallet, so users control their own private keys. Coinbase Web3 Wallet supports multiple blockchain networks, including Ethereum-compatible networks. Coinbase Web3 Wallet is available as a mobile app and a browser extension. Coinbase Web3 Wallet is developed by Coinbase.

Bitget Wallet is a non-custodial multi-chain wallet, so users hold their own private keys. Bitget Wallet includes a built-in token swap feature. Bitget Wallet is available as a mobile app and a browser extension. Bitget Wallet was formerly known as BitKeep.
